programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and movement is in the foreground at we move Austria school. The aim of the ORF initiative is to digitally reach schooles and teachers with short movement units and thus to have them taken daily in the Esterreichian classrooms. Neither gymnasium nor sports clothing or special councilors are necessary for this. As an uncomplicated, daily range of movements for the classroom, we want to move Austria school for more exercise and a healthy and balanced way of life. At the start of the expansion of the initiative. We move Austria, 30 episodes with a duration of six to eight minutes with tailor -made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom. The focus is on power, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better use the often stressful school day. The movement units are pronounced by the qualified sports teacher Karin Wildeder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.desc: The Champions League in Ice Hockey is an international competition for the best European teams that has had its premiere release in the 2014/2015 season. The competition was founded by the International Federation of Ice Hockey in Partnership with the Six Best European League with the aim of continuing the tradition of "European Trophy" competitions and united the best team of Europe. / Liga šampiona u hokeju na ledu je međunarodno takmičenje za najbolje evropske ekipe koje je svoje premijerno izdanje imalo u sezoni 2014./2015. Takmičenje je osnovala Međunarodna federacija hokeja na ledu u partnerstvu sa šest najboljih evropskih liga sa ciljem da nastavi tradiciju "European Trophy" takmičenja i objedini najbolje ekipe Evrope.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. programme.desc: The dragons at the beginning of the season certainly cannot be the most satisfied, as they have said goodbye to European competitions prematurely, and in the Telemach first league they quickly gained a big backlog behind the first ... / Zmaji z začetkom sezone zagotovo ne morejo biti najbolj zadovoljni, saj so se predčasno poslovili od evropskih tekmovanj, tudi v Prvi Ligi Telemach pa so si hitro nabrali velik zaostanek za prvim...

programme.title: Basketball - French League: Le Mans - Paris / Košarka - Francoska liga: Le Mans - Paris

programme.desc: The Turkish Football League better known as the Super League is the highest rank of Turkish football and at the same time the most popular sports competition in the whole country. 18 teams are competing for the title, most of the ... / Turška nogometna liga bolj poznana pod imenom Super Lig je najvišji rang turškega nogometa in hkrati najpopularnejše športno tekmovanje v celotni državi. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: There are bodensee / WaPo Bodensee
programme.desc: The slightly injured and confused older gentleman, whom the Wapo Lake Constance saves from the water, proves to be an important witness in a murder case. The painter Carl Glanzer drives lifeless next to a sailing yacht that the shipyard owner Weyrich allegedly left him in exchange for a picture a week ago. Mechthild makes big eyes when her daughter Nele carelessly gives the name at dinner. Because Zielke was once a world -famous photographer who also photographed Mechthild in her youth. Niklas liked to see the black and white pictures from grandma's past. The investigators have no hot track. The last text message from Glanzer's cell phone went to museum chief Florian Nietzsche and also affected his wife Hanna, who separated from him six months ago and now lives in Portugal. Julia springs exactly that he does not hide something. Jakob has to spend himself as a target of a break -in attempt. When examining the pictures in the artist's studio, Paul makes a surprising discovery, all of which makes excitement. Because Mechthild has also rescheduled the contact to Zielke and is now in mortal danger. / Der leicht verletzte und verwirrte altere Herr Zielke, den die WaPo Bodensee aus dem Wasser rettet, erweist sich als wichtiger Zeuge in einem Mordfall. Der Maler Carl Glanzer treibt leblos neben einer Segelyacht, die ihm der Werftbesitzer Weyrich angeblich vor einer Woche im Tausch gegen ein Bild uberlassen hat. Mechthild macht gleich groSSe Augen, als ihre Tochter Nele unbedacht beim Abendessen den Namen nennt. Denn Zielke war einst ein weltberuhmter Fotograf, der auch Mechthild in ihrer Jugend fotografiert hat. Niklas mochte gerne die Schwarz-WeiSS-Bilder aus Omas Vergangenheit sehen. Die Ermittler haben wahrenddessen noch keine heiSSe Spur. Die letzte Textnachricht von Glanzers Handy ging an Museumschef Florian Nietzsche und betraf auch dessen Frau Hanna, die sich vor einem halben Jahr von ihm getrennt hat und nun in Portugal lebt. Dass er etwas verschweigt, spurt Julia genau. Als Zielkes Haus Ziel eines Einbruchsversuchs wird, muss sich Jakob bei ihm einquartieren. Paul macht bei der Untersuchung der Bilder im Atelier des Kunstlers eine uberraschende Entdeckung, die alle in Aufregung versetzt. Denn auch Mechthild hat den Kontakt zu Zielke wieder aufgenommen und schwebt nun in Lebensgefahr.

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - nature / Wissen vor acht - Natur
programme.desc: In this episode there is music, not for us humans, but for our pets. The University of Wisconsin has developed very special "cat music", suitable in the frequency, in which cats communicate. In the test, the music was so well received that the cats not only listened to the speakers, but even custody with them. According to the study, dogs prefer reggae and soft skirt. Very cool, thinks Thomas D and raps at "Knowledge before eight - nature". / In dieser Folge steckt Musik, nicht fur uns Menschen, sondern fur unsere Haustiere. Die Universitat von Wisconsin hat ganz spezielle "Katzen-Musik" entwickelt, passend in der Frequenz, in der Katzen kommunizieren. Im Test kam die Musik so gut an, dass die Katzen nicht nur an den Lautsprechern lauschten, sondern sogar mit ihnen schmusten. Hunde hingegen bevorzugen laut Studie Reggae und Softrock. Sehr cool, findet Thomas D und rappt bei "Wissen vor acht - Natur".

programme.title: The Savior - we are a lawyer / Die Heiland - Wir sind Anwalt
programme.desc: The propSite Heiko Podolke (Wanja Mues) is accused of realizations. Michaela Tampke (Kirsten Block), the leading actress of a feature film, collapsed on a folding chair during filming in the Babelsberg studio, and Heiko is held responsible for this. The expensive film production stands still, every day causes high costs. Michaela Tampke is not just the main actress: the film to which she wrote the script she recedes her life story as an actress in the GDR of the 80s. For many years, Michaela has been looking for a film production company that was able to finance and produce this film - its life dream -; In the film team in Babelsberg, you still know some from GDR times. But the folding chair itself also has a past. It is a GDR design, whose author Heiko Podolke himself is, who, however, stood out to secure his sample rights to the design. It turns out that the chair was manipulated. Who from the film team wanted to harm Michaela Tampke? Or has Heiko Podolke hung up the chair himself? Chief Prosecutor Tummler does not investigate the preload of the money washing against Romy alone, he has a vulnerable support from a young colleague. Veronica Strauss (Anne Muller) does everything possible to prove Romy errors. The fact that Romy is supposed to have a young half sister raises questions. Who is Serafina? Should Romy really believe her? What did your parents not help you? Romy's life so far has been used to be used in its foundations. / Dem Requisiteur Heiko Podolke (Wanja Mues) wird Fahrlassigkeit vorgeworfen. Michaela Tampke (Kirsten Block), die Hauptdarstellerin eines Spielfilms, ist wahrend Dreharbeiten im Studio Babelsberg auf einem Klappstuhl zusammengebrochen, und Heiko wird dafur verantwortlich gemacht. Die teure Filmproduktion steht still, jeder Tag verursacht hohe Kosten. Michaela Tampke ist nicht nur die Hauptdarstellerin: Der Film, zu dem sie selbst das Drehbuch geschrieben hat, erzahlt ihre Lebensgeschichte als Schauspielerin in der DDR der 80er Jahre. Viele Jahre hat Michaela eine Filmproduktionsfirma gesucht, die diesen Film - ihren Lebenstraum - finanzieren und produzieren konnte; im Filmteam in Babelsberg kennen sie einige noch aus DDR-Zeiten. Aber auch der Klappstuhl selbst hat eine Vergangenheit. Es handelt sich um ein DDR-Design, dessen Urheber Heiko Podolke selbst ist, der es jedoch versaumte, seine Musterrechte an dem Design zu sichern.Es stellt sich heraus, dass der Stuhl manipuliert wurde. Wer aus dem Filmteam wollte Michaela Tampke schaden? Oder hat Heiko Podolke selbst den Stuhl angesagt?Oberstaatsanwalt Tummler ermittelt nicht allein zu den Vorwurfen der Geldwasche gegen Romy, er hat tatkraftige Unterstutzung durch eine junge Kollegin. Veronica Strauss (Anne Muller) setzt alles daran, Romy Fehler nachzuweisen.Die Tatsache, dass Romy eine jungere Halbschwester haben soll, wirft Fragen auf. Wer ist Serafina? Soll Romy ihr wirklich glauben? Was haben ihr ihre Eltern nicht erzahlt? Romys bisheriges Leben wird in seinen Grundfesten erschuttert.

programme.title: In all friendship / In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: After a traffic accident, the teen maddder Greta Dahn is brought to the Sachsenklinik seriously injured. For Dr. Lucia Bohm is not a common patient because she both connects a well -walked secret. After such a long time being unprepared to be confronted with her past, Lucia wages up and her professionality gives way to overwhelming. This also escapes Dr. Kai Hoffmann not, who first gets to know another side of his colleague. ARZU Ritter suddenly has an emotional outbreak in the morning when she looks at family photos. Dr. Philipp Brentano is affected, what about her? Further evidence drove to expect the two to expect a baby to expect what they had thought impossible for the beginning of the menopause. / Das Teenager-Madchen Greta Dahn wird nach einem Verkehrsunfall schwerverletzt in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Fur Dr. Lucia Bohm ist Greta keine gewohnliche Patientin, denn sie beide verbindet ein wohlgehutetes Geheimnis. Nach so langer Zeit unvorbereitet mit ihrer Vergangenheit konfrontiert zu werden, wuhlt Lucia auf und ihre Professionalitat weicht der Überforderung. Das entgeht auch Dr. Kai Hoffmann nicht, der das erste Mal eine andere Seite an seiner Kollegin kennenlernt.Arzu Ritter hat morgens plotzlich einen emotionalen Ausbruch, als sie sich Familienfotos ansieht. Dr. Philipp Brentano ist betroffen, was ist mit ihr? Weitere Indizien fuhren dazu, dass die beiden glauben, ein Baby zu erwarten, was sie wegen der beginnenden Wechseljahre bei Arzu fur unmoglich gehalten hatten.

programme.title: Mister Paper / Mister Paper
programme.desc: In a world of paper and cardboard, the headstrong Mister Paper lives a cheerful life with his cat. Equipped with scissors and glue, he tackles his surroundings as he needs. For every problem, Mister Paper has an imaginative and creative solution ready, which he immediately puts into practice with the help of his never -ending paper stock. Only sometimes his creations have their own head, so Mister Paper has to become creative again to deal with their idiosyncrasies. But with the help of his loyal cat, the paper hero always ensures that everything will be fine at the end of every episode. / In einer Welt aus Papier und Pappe lebt der eigensinnige Mister Paper mit seiner Katze ein heiteres Leben. Ausgestattet mit Schere und Kleber bastelt er sich seine Umgebung so zusammen, wie er sie gerade braucht. Fur jedes Problem hat Mister Paper eine fantasievolle und kreative Losung parat, die er mithilfe seines nie enden wollenden Papiervorrats sogleich in die Tat umsetzt. Nur manchmal haben seine Kreationen ihren eigenen Kopf, sodass Mister Paper wieder kreativ werden muss, um mit ihren Eigenwilligkeiten umzugehen. Aber mithilfe seiner treuen Katze sorgt der Papierheld stets dafur, dass am Ende jeder Episode alles gut wird.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini / ZIB Zack Mini
Bizarre food: culinary trips / Skurrile Kost: Kulinarische Reisen
programme.desc: Master chef Andrew Zimmer pretends unique dishes from the vibrating metropolises in the world. Traveling has never been so expensive. The experienced flavors visited top restaurants, meets renowned cooks and cooks and dives deep into the cultural and historical roots of the dishes on offer. It quickly becomes clear that food is more than just food - it is a window to the soul of a culture! This time the diverse culinary enjoyment of Brookly is in the center. The multicultural district offers classics such as wonderful juicy steaks, real New York pizza, Judic baking dipped in chocolate and hearty cheesecake. / Meisterkoch Andrew Zimmern prasentiert einzigartige Speisen aus den vibrierenden Metropolen der Welt. Reisen war noch nie so kostlich. Der erfahrene Geschmacksentdecker besucht Top-Restaurants, trifft renommierte Kochinnen und Koche und taucht tief in die kulturellen und historischen Wurzeln der angebotenen Gerichte ein. Schnell wird klar: Essen ist mehr als nur Nahrung - es ist ein Fenster zur Seele einer Kultur!Im Zentrum stehen diesmal die vielfaltigen kulinarischen Genusse von Brooklyn. Der multikulturelle Stadtteil bietet Klassiker wie herrlich saftige Steaks, echte New York-Pizza, in Schokolade getunktes judisches Geback und herzhaften Cheesecake.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.desc: The almost two -year orphan Tommy finds a finger in the park. Monk quickly closes the boy into his heart and takes him up to him. In the meantime, Monk is convinced that the finger comes from a musician. He states that it is the violinist Daniel Carlysle. As it turns out, his family is in contact with kidnappers who developed Daniel. / Das knapp zweijahrige Waisenkind Tommy findet im Park einen Finger. Monk schlieSSt den Buben schnell in sein Herz und nimmt ihn vorubergehend bei sich auf. Inzwischen kommt Monk zu der Überzeugung, dass der Finger von einem Musiker stammt. Er mutmaSSt, dass es sich dabei um den Violinisten Daniel Carlysle handelt. Wie sich zeigt, steht dessen Familie in Kontakt mit Kidnappern, die Daniel entfuhrt haben.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: When the 16-year-old Ira finds out that it was created by a sperm donation, the girl absolutely wants to get to know his biological father. Shortly after she picked up the search, she is found lifeless on a park bench. Next to her is a flyer of the reproductive clinic in which it was created. While commissioner Kiesewetter tries to investigate the biological father, his colleague Engler follows a different trace. programme.title: Crime scene / Tatort
programme.desc: Human remains are discovered in an apartment. Maryam Azadi and Hamza Kulina quickly find that the murder has been lying out for a few years - and that the handwriting of the tater is reminiscent of other unbelievable murder trap. The two drove the two to a nested serial wear, which seems to have been able to have a almost perfect double life. But when the media experienced the discovery of the body and with their reporting the determination of danger, the two come under pressure to identify the victims as quickly as possible. Maryam and Hamza only remain a few days to work through crime files until the 1970s and finally give grieving loved ones certainty. In the further course, the two of them still come across a victim who at first glance does not fit into the pattern of the serial murder, but could give the case a new cruel turn. / Bei einer Wohnungsauflosung werden menschliche Überreste entdeckt. Schnell stellen Maryam Azadi und Hamza Kulina fest, dass der Mord schon einige Jahre zuruckliegt - und dass die Handschrift des Taters an andere ungeloste Mordfalle erinnert. Die Hinweise fuhren die beiden zu einem beruchtigten Serienmorder, der ein nahezu perfektes Doppelleben gefuhrt zu haben scheint. Doch als die Medien von dem Fund der Leichenteile erfahren und mit ihrer Berichterstattung die Ermittlung gefahrden, geraten die beiden unter Druck, die Opfer schnellstmoglich zu identifizieren. Maryam und Hamza bleiben nur wenige Tage, um Kriminalakten bis in die 1970er Jahre durchzuarbeiten und trauernden Angehorigen endlich Gewissheit zu geben. Im weiteren Verlauf stoSSen die beiden noch auf ein Opfer, das auf den ersten Blick zwar nicht in das Muster des Serienmorders passt, aber dem Fall eine neue grausame Wendung geben konnte.

programme.title: Citizenwalt / Burgeranwalt
programme.desc: No summer care for girls with the three-year disability, Petra N. fights that her 10-year daughter, who lives with Triso-mie 21 and a pacemaker, can take up summer care at her folk school in Eastern Styria. The advantage: Katharina can stay in the usual environment, be together with her friends and get the usual care, as well as during the school year. But there is no demand for this summer care by the state of Styria. People's lawyer Bernhard Achitz. Disclusion for victims of violence was not deferred for violent victims who had become victims of violence and abuse in the federal deaf and dumb between 1945 and 1999. After the public prosecutor's office made aware of this grievance and reported the broadcast Burgeranwalter Daruber, something started moving. In the studio, Martin Netzer, head of the section in the educational minis, was explained. The 30-year farmer Sebastian H. searched for an excavator for a long time. When he discovered a classified ad with an excavator online on a large and renown-mated agricultural platform, he does not long. He gets in touch with the supposed seller and points the purchase price of around 25,000 euros. But the excavator is never delivered. How do the investigators proceed in such a case, what liability issues are presenting for the online platforms and how likely is it that the young farmer gets his money again? A police investigator, a lawyer of the affected platform and an expert from the VKI in the studio. / Keine Sommerbetreuung fur Madchen mit BehinderungSeit drei Jahren kampft Petra N. darum, dass ihre 10-jahrige Tochter, die mit Triso-mie 21 und einem Herzschrittmacher lebt, die Sommerbetreuung an ihrer Volks-schule in der Oststeiermark in Anspruch nehmen kann. Der Vorteil: Katharina kann in der gewohnten Umgebung bleiben, mit ihren Freundinnen und Freunden zu-sammen sein und bekommt die gewohnte Betreuung, wie auch wahrend des Schuljahres. Doch fur diese Sommerbetreuung gibt es keine Forderung durch das Land Steiermark. Zu Unrecht, meint Volksanwalt Bernhard Achitz.Entschadigung fur GewaltopferBisher wurden gehorlose Personen, die in den damaligen Taubstummenanstalten des Bundes zwischen 1945 und 1999 Opfer von Gewalt und Missbrauch geworden waren, nicht entschadigt. Nachdem die Volksanwaltschaft auf diesen Missstand aufmerksam gemacht und die Sendung Burgeranwalt daruber berichtet hatte, kam etwas in Bewegung. Im Studio erklart Martin Netzer, Sektionschef im Bildungsminis-teriums, welche Losung gefunden wurde.BaggerbetrugSchon lange hat der 30-jahrige Landwirt Sebastian H. nach einem Bagger gesucht, der ihm seine Arbeit am Hof erleichtert. Als er online auf einer groSSen und renom-mierten Landwirtschaftsplattform eine Kleinanzeige mit einem Bagger entdeckt, zo-gert er nicht lange. Er tritt mit dem vermeintlichen Verkaufer in Kontakt und uber-weist den Kaufpreis von rund 25.000 Euro. Doch der Bagger wird nie geliefert. Wie gehen die Ermittler in so einem Fall vor, welche Haftungsfragen stellen sich fur die Onlineplattformen und wie wahrscheinlich ist es, dass der Jungbauer sein Geld wieder bekommt?Dazu diskutieren ein Polizeiermittler, ein Anwalt der betroffenen Plattform und eine Expertin des VKI im Studio.

programme.desc: Militant animal welfareers free animals and cause great damage. The damaged Grounds A Burgerwehr, there are clashes. programme.title: Meryn on Monday / MERYN am Montag
programme.desc: A debate about euthanasia has arisen in Austria in recent weeks. The assisted suicide aid has been legally allowed since Janner 2022, active euthanasia - to death on request - is prohibited. The regulation for the assisted suicide is particularly critical of the church as well as the hospice and palliative facilities. Rather, they pursue the goal of patient with life -distant to stabilize non -curable diseases, so that they were able to raise some confidence again, but are the existing palliative offers so that the decision can be made freely? And what role should the media and the public play in such sensitive individual traps? Siegfried Meryn answers their questions together with Christine Fruhling, Lower Austria patient and nursing lawyer, in Meryn on Monday. Send us your questions or experience by email to medical@orf.at or via WhatsApp at +43/1/87878-25614. / In Österreich ist in den vergangenen Wochen eine Debatte rund um das Thema Sterbehilfe entstanden. Rein rechtlich ist die assistierte Suizidhilfe seit Janner 2022 erlaubt, aktive Euthanasie - Totung auf Verlangen - ist verboten. Kritisch sehen die Regelung fur den assistierten Suizid vor allem die Kirche sowie die Hospiz- und Palliativeinrichtungen. Sie verfolgen vielmehr das Ziel PatientInnen mit lebensverkurzenden, nicht heilbaren Erkrankungen zu stabilisieren, sodass sie wieder etwas Zuversicht schopfen konnten.Aber reichen die bestehenden Palliativangebote aus, damit die Entscheidung frei getroffen werden kann? Und welche Rolle sollen Medien und Öffentlichkeit bei so sensiblen Einzelfallen spielen?Siegfried Meryn beantwortet Ihre Fragen zusammen mit Christine Fruhling, NÖ Patienten- und Pflegeanwaltschaft, in MERYN am Montag. Schicken Sie uns Ihre Fragen oder Erfahrungen per Mail an medizin@orf.at oder via WhatsApp unter +43/1/87878-25614.

programme.title: The health crash - Austria's medicine at the limit / Der Gesundheits-Crash - Österreichs Medizin am Limit
programme.desc: Long waiting times in the outpatient clinics, fewer and fewer domestic doctors, and the Austrian health insurance company provides painful shortcuts. Many have been a long time that the Esterreichische Health System has been in a heavy imbalance. But now well -known doctors are now coming to an even clearer finding: Health care as we know them can be history in two years, if not massively countermeased today. Designer Manuel Obermeier leaves prominent doctors on the theme Monday new production. They draw the image of a stretched and neglected system that can only be saved with hard measures. / Lange Wartezeiten in den Ambulanzen, immer weniger Hausarzte, und die Österreichische Gesundheitskasse kundigt schmerzhafte Leistungskurzungen an. Vielen dammert schon langer, dass das osterreichische Gesundheitssystem in eine schwere Schieflage geraten ist. Doch jetzt kommen jetzt namhafte Medizinerinnen und Mediziner zu einem noch deutlicheren Befund: Die Gesundheitsversorgung, wie wir sie kennen, kann in zwei Jahren Geschichte sein, wenn nicht heute massiv gegengesteuert wird. In der Themenmontag Neuproduktion lasst Gestalter Manuel Obermeier prominente Ärzte und Ärztinnen, die in hohen Leitungsfunktionen sind oder waren, zu Wort kommen. Sie zeichnen das Bild eines uberdehnten und vernachlassigten Systems, das nur mehr mit harten MaSSnahmen zu retten ist.

programme.title: The tricks with our health / Die Tricks mit unserer Gesundheit
programme.desc: Blood pressure agents, cholesterol, cancer medication: In Germany, increasingly important medicines are missing. The supply of antibiotics is also becoming more and more a problem. Why is that? Moderator Jo Hiller is on the trail of the threatening narrow fit for medication. Just like the long waiting times for a specialist date. For statutory health insurers, this has almost become normal, regardless of whether routine examination or acute pain. Jo Hiller meets patients, doctors and searches for solutions with them. What are the billions in the healthcare system at all? And what benefits do the statutory health insurance companies take, which not? A comprehensive research with exciting findings. / Blutdruckmittel, Cholesterinsenker, Krebsmedikamente: In Deutschland fehlen zunehmend wichtige Arzneimittel. Auch die Versorgung mit Antibiotika wird immer mehr zum Problem. Woran liegt das? Moderator Jo Hiller ist den bedrohlichen Engpassen bei Medikamenten auf der Spur. Ebenso wie den langen Wartezeiten auf einen Facharzttermin. Fur gesetzlich Krankenversicherte ist das fast schon normal geworden, egal ob Routineuntersuchung oder akute Schmerzen. Jo Hiller trifft Patientinnen und Patienten, Ärztinnen und Ärzte und sucht mit ihnen nach Losungen. Wofur werden die Milliarden im Gesundheitswesen uberhaupt ausgegeben? Und welche Leistungen ubernehmen die gesetzlichen Krankenkassen, welche nicht? Eine umfassende Recherche mit spannenden Erkenntnissen.

programme.title: Help, my hospital dies! / Hilfe, mein Krankenhaus stirbt!
programme.desc: The hospital in Varel in the Friesland district has been writing red numbers for a long time. Most stations are now closed by the hospital reform, the house is converted into an outpatient surgical center. This drives burgers, foster and medical profession onto the street. With vigils, they warn of poor supply in the landing region. The German hospital system is in a deep crisis: bankruptcy, lack of staff, too high costs. Germany belongs to the top of health expenditure worldwide, as well as 100,000 inhabitants in the number of hospital. At the same time, the life expectancy of the Germans is only in the lower third. / Das Krankenhaus in Varel im Landkreis Friesland schreibt schon lange rote Zahlen. Jetzt werden durch die Krankenhausreform die meisten Stationen geschlossen, das Haus wird in ein ambulantes Operationszentrum umgewandelt. Das treibt Burgerinnen und Burger, Pflegekrafte und Ärzteschaft auf die StraSSe. Mit Mahnwachen warnen sie vor einer schlechten Versorgung in der landlichen Region. Das deutsche Krankenhaussystem steckt in einer tiefen Krise: Insolvenzen, Personalmangel, zu hohe Kosten. Deutschland gehort bei den Gesundheitsausgaben weltweit zur Spitze, ebenso bei der Anzahl von Krankenhausern je 100.000 Einwohner. Gleichzeitig liegt die Lebenserwartung der Deutschen aber nur im unteren Drittel.

programme.title: Meryn's consulting room / MERYNS sprechzimmer
programme.desc: Anyone who likes to find out more about opportunities, risks and the latest knowledge of the weight loss injection is the right place in this consulting room. In this program we take a detailed look at the current developments around Ozempic and Co. and their applications as weight loss injection. Experts explain how this drug treatment- as a GLP-1 agonist- works: it influences the hunger and custody chair, regulates blood sugar levels, which helps many people lose weight. We look at the latest studies that have driven significant weight loss in certain patient groups and can significantly reduce the risk for secondary diseases such as type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure and cardiovascular diseases. Affected people also report positive effects such as more energy, better well -being and an improved quality of life. So an absolute miracle cure? Jein. Of course there are also side effects such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or constipation. Some people complain about stomach problems or loss of appetite. In rare falling, serious side effects can occur, such as pancreatitis or allergic reactions. Therefore, a doctor's accompaniment when using this syringe is inexertwus. We also show what risks and limits the treatment has and for whom it is suitable. Siegfried Meryn discusses with: Florian Kiefer, specialist for internal medicine, endocrinology and metabolism, Simone Parzer, clinical psychologist and health psychologist as well as Klaus Haslinger, obesity patient, in Meryn's consulting room. / Wer mehr uber Chancen, Risiken und die neuesten Erkenntnisse zur Abnehmspritze erfahren mochte, ist in diesem Sprechzimmer genau richtig. In dieser Sendung werfen wir einen detaillierten Blick auf die aktuellen Entwicklungen rund um Ozempic und Co. und ihren Anwendungen als Abnehmspritze. Experten erklaren, wie diese medikamentose Behandlung - als GLP-1-Agonist - funktioniert: Sie beeinflusst das Hunger- und Sattigungsgefuhl, reguliert den Blutzuckerspiegel, was vielen Menschen beim Abnehmen hilft. Wir schauen auf die neuesten Studien, die bei bestimmten Patientengruppen zu signifikantem Gewichtsverlust fuhren und das Risiko fur Folgeerkrankungen wie Diabetes Typ 2, Bluthochdruck und Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen erheblich senken konnen. Betroffene berichten zudem von positiven Effekten wie mehr Energie, besserem Wohlbefinden und einer verbesserten Lebensqualitat. Also ein absolutes Wundermittel? Jein. Naturlich gibt es auch Nebenwirkungen wie Übelkeit, Erbrechen, Durchfall oder Verstopfung. Manche Menschen klagen uber Magenbeschwerden oder Appetitlosigkeit. In seltenen Fallen konnen ernsthaftere Nebenwirkungen auftreten, wie Pankreatitis oder allergische Reaktionen. Deshalb ist eine arztliche Begleitung bei der Anwendung dieser Spritze unerlasslich. Wir zeigen auch, welche Risiken und Grenzen die Behandlung hat und fur wen sie geeignet ist. Siegfried Meryn diskutiert dazu zusammen mit: Florian Kiefer, Facharzt fur Innere Medizin, Endokrinologie und Stoffwechsel, Simone Parzer, Klinische Psychologin und Gesundheitspsychologin sowie Klaus Haslinger, Adipositas-Patient, in MERYNS sprechzimmer.

programme.title: Meeting point medicine / treffpunkt medizin
programme.desc: Fat away by injection: A new therapy approach awakens hopes in overweight people who, despite great efforts, do not lose weight permanently. What are the risks? A billion people worldwide are obesity. In addition to changing the detention and movement, a diabetes drug should now help - even in people who have not yet suffered diabetes. People with Diabetes Type 2 are actually treated with the active ingredient semaglutid. Since it has become known that it has led to weight loss, the medication has led to a hype under the trade name Ozempic and Wegovy on social media. On average, patients lose 16 percent body weight with this medication. But the scientific data situation is not yet extensive, long -term studies have not yet been completed. At the same time, the pharmaceutical industry is already developing other medications that promise even more weight loss. A billion market attracts. The 3sat science documentation "Wunder remedy weight loss injection" accompanies patients who have declared their overweight fight and hope to become easier with the syringe. It questions the current state of research and lets endocrinologists like Susanne Reger-Tan speak, but also Martina de Zwaan, who is researching the board of the German obesity society and for psychosomatics in overweight. A fact -based analysis that is based on opportunities, but also risks of the new weight loss ingredient. / Fett weg per Injektion: Ein neuer Therapieansatz weckt Hoffnungen bei ubergewichtigen Menschen, die trotz groSSer Anstrengungen nicht dauerhaft abnehmen. Worin bestehen die Risiken? Eine Milliarde Menschen weltweit sind adipos. Neben Ernahrungsumstellung und Bewegung soll jetzt ein Diabetesmedikament helfen - auch bei Menschen, die noch nicht an Diabetes erkrankt sind.Mit dem Wirkstoff Semaglutid werden eigentlich Menschen mit Diabetes Typ2 behandelt. Seit bekannt geworden ist, dass er zu Gewichtsverlust fuhrt, hat das Medikament unter dem Handelsnamen Ozempic und Wegovy auf Social Media zu einem Hype gefuhrt. Im Durchschnitt verlieren Patienten 16 Prozent Korpergewicht mit diesem Medikament. Doch die wissenschaftliche Datenlage ist noch nicht umfangreich, Langzeitstudien noch nicht abgeschlossen. Parallel entwickelt die Pharmaindustrie bereits weitere Medikamente, die noch mehr Gewichtsverlust versprechen. Ein Milliardenmarkt lockt.Die 3sat-Wissenschaftsdokumentation "Wundermittel Abnehmspritze" begleitet Patientinnen und Patienten, die ihrem Übergewicht den Kampf angesagt haben und die hoffen, mit der Spritze leichter zu werden. Sie hinterfragt den aktuellen Stand der Forschung und lasst Endokrinologinnen wie Susanne Reger-Tan zu Wort kommen, aber auch Martina de Zwaan, die dem Vorstand der Deutschen Adipositas-Gesellschaft angehort und zur Psychosomatik bei Übergewicht forscht. Eine faktenbasierte Analyse, die Chancen, aber auch Risiken des neuen Abnehmwirkstoffs ergrundet.

programme.title: Caretaker Krause - order must be / Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein
programme.desc: In the comedy series "Caretaker Krause", everything revolves around Dieter Krause (played by Tom Gerhardt), who would like to turn things to his advantage, but steps in all kinds of fat and in the "Kalker Weg 5" residential complex in Koln-Kalk has to take care of order. Unfortunately, he and some tenants have a completely different idea of ​​what that should mean. There is also some turbulence for the family man. Carmen did not expect that: her pregnancy test is positive. But who could be the father from the host of their admirers? In view of the illegitimate offspring, Dieter panic in this episode. If the physical is not to be found, replacement must be found. And who would be more suitable than Dieter's idiotic friend Herbert? But just when he could be convinced by his paternity, the biological father appears: a dream of a man ... / In der Comedy-Serie "Hausmeister Krause" dreht sich alles um Dieter Krause (gespielt von Tom Gerhardt), der die Dinge am liebsten zu seinem Vorteil drehen mochte, dabei aber in allerlei Fettnapfchen tritt und in der Wohnanlage "Kalker Weg 5" in Koln-Kalk alle Hande voll zu tun hat fur Ordnung zu sorgen. Leider haben er und einige Mieter eine ganz andere Vorstellung davon, was das bedeuten soll. Auch familiar gibt es einige Turbulenzen fur den Familienvater. Damit hat Carmen nicht gerechnet: Ihr Schwangerschaftstest ist positiv. Doch wer aus der Heerschar ihrer Verehrer konnte der Vater sein? Was drinsteckt - und wie viel sie noch mit den Originalen zu tun haben, zeigt Sebastian Lege.Sebastian Lege nimmt vier Kultprodukte der DDR genauer unter die Lupe. Dabei zeigt er, wie die Menschen in der DDR mit wenigen verfugbaren Rohstoffen kreative Losungen fanden - und welche dieser Tricks die Lebensmittelindustrie bis heute nutzt.Halloren-Kugeln waren in der DDR eine Raritat - sogenannte "Buckware", die Verkaufer nur unter dem Ladentisch hervorholten. Die Rezeptur ist laut Hersteller seit DDR-Zeiten unverandert. Sebastian Lege zeigt, was drinsteckt und wie die Masse langfristig sahnig und cremig bleibt. Bei einer Verkostung in Leipzig zeigt sich: Die Halloren-Kugeln wecken bei vielen Ostdeutschen nostalgische Erinnerungen, die Meinungen zur Rezeptur sind gemischt.Soljanka, die tomatige Suppe mit Fleisch und sauren Gurken, war in der DDR ein echter Klassiker. Ursprunglich als kreative Resteverwertung gedacht, ist sie heute als Fertigprodukt erhaltlich. Sebastian Lege zeigt, wie die Industrie mit nostalgischen Verpackungen wirbt, wahrend die Inhaltsstoffe mit der traditionellen Zubereitung kaum noch etwas gemeinsam haben. Statt frischer Zutaten setzt die Industrie-Soljanka auf gunstige Zusatzstoffe fur Haltbarkeit und Konsistenz. So entsteht ein perfekt gesteuertes Produkt mit extrem vielen Zutaten. Im Vergleich dazu demonstriert der 71-jahrige Koch Erich Klukas, wie eine authentische DDR-Soljanka mit frischen Zutaten zubereitet wird.Als Kaffee in der DDR knapp war, bot der Malzkaffee "Im Nu" eine Alternative. Sebastian Lege erklart, wie aus Gerste, Roggen und Gerstenmalz ein kaffeeahnliches Getrank entsteht. Beim Rosten karamellisiert der Malzzucker und erzeugt eine braune Farbe sowie einen suSSlich-intensiven Geschmack. Der Ersatzkaffee hat auch heute noch seine Berechtigung: Er ist koffeinfrei, hat eine bessere CO2-Bilanz als echter Kaffee und weckt bei vielen nostalgische Erinnerungen an die Kindheit.1953 entwickelte Kathe Thiele das erste Tortenmehl Deutschlands - eine Innovation, die berufstatigen Frauen den Haushalt erleichtern sollte. Heute bietet die Firma Kathi Dutzende verschiedener Backmischungen an, darunter auch Torten, die ganz ohne Backen auskommen. Sebastian Lege zeigt am Beispiel einer Erdbeertorte, wie die Industrie mit Aromen, Farbstoffen und Ersatzstoffen arbeitet. Bei einer Verkostung mochte Sebastian Lege herausfinden: Fallt das uberhaupt auf?Sebastian Lege zeigt in dieser Folge, wie die Menschen in der DDR mit wenigen Rohstoffen viel moglich gemacht haben. Einige dieser Tricks nutzt die Lebensmittelindustrie bis heute. Wahrend die Produkte damals aus der Not heraus entstanden, stellt sich heute die Frage: Warum werden die Rezepturen nicht verbessert, obwohl alle Zutaten verfugbar sind?

(Shekel) / מרי ברי וחברתה הטובה, המנחה קלאודיה ווינקלמן, מתארחות בבית קפה המשמש גם עבור שיעורי בישול. קלאודיה מפקפקת בכישורי הבישול שלה גם עם עזרתה של מרי, אך יחד הן מכינות ארוחה טעימה, שכמעט ולא דורשת מאמץ. (שח)

programme.title: Eva's Asian cuisine, new! Chapter 5 / המטבח האסייתי של אווה, חדש! פרק 5
programme.desc: Eva will present three recipes for particularly popular doses, beef sautéed and black beans and Chinese -style chicken stew. (Shekel) / אווה תציג שלושה מתכונים למנות פופולריות במיוחד סאטה עוף, מוקפץ בקר ושעועית שחורה ותבשיל עוף בקארי בסגנון סיני. (שח)

programme.title: Luca 3's classic ingredient, new! Chapter 3 / המרכיב הקלאסי של לוקה 3, חדש! פרק 3
programme.desc: Luca is using Parmagno Regano of various ages to make a variety of dishes, ranging from an innovative sandwich made of cheesecake, liquid stuffing and pears with Moss Fermagano Reggiano. (Shekel) / לוקה משתמש בפרמגאנו רגאנו בגילאים שונים להכנת מגוון מנות, החל מכריך חדשני עשוי מקריספ גבינה, רביולי במלית נוזלית ואגסים שלוקים עם מוס פרמגיאנו רגיאנו.כ עב. (שח)

programme.title: Gimi healthy, new cook! Chapter 3 / גיימי מבשל בריא, חדש! פרק 3
programme.desc: Gimi Oliver prepares healthy and nutritious recipes that will provide us with what the body needs. And this time peaches with oatmeal porridge, mosques with strawberries and pistachio and a dalorial risotto with chestnut cream. (Shekel) / גיימי אוליבר מכין מתכונים בריאים ומזינים שיספקו לנו על מה שהגוף צריך. והפעם מלבה אפרסקים עם דייסת שיבולת שועל, מאפי פילו עם תותים ופיסטוק וריזוטו דלורית עם קרם ערמונים. (שח)

programme.title: Real recipes with Donel, New! Chapter 1 / מתכונים בזמן אמת עם דונל, חדש! פרק 1
programme.desc: Donel presents us with four winning and comforting recipes of pasta, such as pasta with chicken and mushrooms in one skillet, pasta with meatballs in tomato sauce and butter and Rago Bianco with crispy sage. (Shekel) / דונל מציג בפנינו ארבעה מתכונים מנצחים ומנחמים של פסטה, כמו פסטה עם עוף ופטריות במחבת אחת, פסטה עם כדורי בשר ברוטב עגבניות וחמאה וראגו ביאנקו עם מרווה פריכה. (שח)

programme.title: Duty Chef 4, New! Chapter 5 / אוף דיוטי שף 4, חדש! פרק 5
programme.desc: Mark Moriarti presents three fish -sided and seafood recipes with Irish bread, minced meat pastry, and roasted lamb market with potatoes. (Shekel) / מארק מוריארטי מציג שלושה מתכונים מנחמים צאודר דגים ופירות ים עם לחם אירי, מאפה בשר טחון, ושוק טלה צלוי עם תפוחי אדמה. (שח)

(Shekel) / אנדלוסיה היא כור היתוך תרבותי של מסורות ודתות. מלחמות שוורים, עצי זיתים ומקום לידתו של ריקוד הפלמנקו כולם חלק מחיי התושבים במקום. (שח)

programme.title: Guana on the Danube River, New! Chapter 2 / גואנה על נהר הדנובה, חדש! פרק 2
programme.desc: In the second part of the journey, Guana focuses mainly on the natural environment of the Danube River, researching the various conservation ventures designed to restore the area and the animals that are in it. (Shekel) / בחלקו השני של המסע, גואנה מתמקדת בעיקר בסביבה הטבעית של נהר הדנובה, חוקרת את מיזמי השימור השונים שנועדו לשקם את האזור ואת בעלי החיים שנמצאים בו. (שח)

programme.title: Away from civilization 11 chapter 7 / הרחק מהציוויליזציה 11 פרק 7
programme.desc: Ben visits Beck and their three children who lives in the most remote location in the desert in Australia as part of a huge conservation project aimed at restoring the native wildlife that were exceeded from the natural term. (Shekel) / בן מבקר לשבוע את בק וריס ושלושת ילדיהם המשפחה שגרה במיקום המרוחק ביותר במדבר באוסטרליה כחלק מפרויקט שימור ענקי שמטרתו להחזיר את חיות הבר הילידיות שהוכחדו ממעונן הטבעי. (שח)

programme.title: Keep from the civilization back to nature 4, new! Chapter 5 / הרחק מהציוויליזציה חזרה לטבע 4, חדש! פרק 5
programme.desc: Ben returns to visit Rory, a resident of Ra'alin, Northern Ireland, who was once a senior human resources manager, until he was abandoned and moved to the island to help with others and humanitarian assistance. (Shekel) / בן חוזר לבקר את רורי, תושב האי רתלין שבצפון אירלנד, מי שהיה פעם מנהל בכיר בתחום משאבי האנוש, עד שנטש ועבר לאי לעסוק בעזרה לזולת וסיוע הומניטרי. (שח)

programme.title: Recipe with Chapter 1 Memory / מתכון עם זיכרון פרק 1
programme.desc: A commemorative venture in collaboration with a recipe association with memory. The Hani dining blogger is forbidden to prepare a stuffed pot with meat in memory of Shai Termin Zel, a paratrooper fighter who fell in Gaza in the iron sword war. As a father. (Shekel) / מיזם הנצחה בשיתוף עמותת מתכון עם זיכרון. בלוגרית האוכל חני אסור מכינה סיר ממולאים עם בשר לזכרו של שי טרמין זל, לוחם צנחנים שנפל בעזה במלחמת חרבות ברזל. כ עב. (שח)

programme.title: Recipe with Chapter 2 Memory / מתכון עם זיכרון פרק 2
programme.desc: A commemorative venture in collaboration with a recipe association with memory. programme.title: Along with Nick / ביחד עם ניק
programme.desc: Special broadcast to raise a smile on the face and release of tensions. programme.title: Pepa pigs in Roma / Pepa prase na romskom jeziku

programme.title: Great Nordic myths / Veliki nordijski mitovi
programme.desc: Producers of the praised documentary series Greek myths, in a new endeavor will try to extract the true meaning of Nordic stories based on the old texts available. The story that influenced some of the most popular blockbusters of today, from Tolkin's lord of the rings until George Martin's throne. / Producenti hvaljene dokumentarne serije Grčki mitovi, u novom poduhvatu pokušaće da izvuku pravo značenje nordijskih priča na osnovu dostupnih starih tekstova. Priča koje su uticale na neke od najpopularnijih blokbastera današnjice, od Tolkinovog Gospodara prstenova do Igre prijestola Džordža Martina.

programme.title: Net.Me / Mreža.me
programme.desc: We are talking about people, events, places, problems, everything you are interested in. Your stories, interesting guests. / Govorimo o ljudima, događajima, mjestima, problemima, o svemu što vas zanima. Vaše priče, interesantni gosti.

programme.title: Living room / Dnevna soba
programme.desc: It is an entertainment program show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The desire is to relax and fun in an hour and a half viewers, to escape the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and family. In numerous columns, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of the interlocutor we share advice for a simpler life. With simple and concrete tips for viewers, we will host numerous individuals or groups dealing with humanitarian work, as well as known personities that we will represent in a slightly different light, give them the opportunity to share their life experiences and small secrets in the functioning of the household. / Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. programme.title: MMA GFC 11 / MMA GFC 11
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. programme.title: Mothers champions / Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Velež - Sloga / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Sloga
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. programme.desc: Charles moves to Kansas with his wife and daughters. The lush Indian landscape already likes him. They quickly settle with their wife and three daughters. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Musical Matinee / Glasbena matineja
Mengeš Youth Folklore Group: Frižekson, Mon. / Mladinska folklorna skupina Mengeš: Frižekson, pon.
programme.desc: R: Vojko Vidmar ... The Mengeš Youth Folklore Group will take you to Carinthia with the choreography of Tomaž Simetinger and wax you "hairdresser"! This is a Slovenian derivative of the German greeting "Frisch und Gsund", with which in Carinthia and in other northern parts of the Slovenian ethnic territory on the day of innocent children, on December 28, walked from house to house and waxed happiness and health before the new year. The joke is also accompanied by a beating in which the vitality and fertility of Šiba is supposed to pass on people. / R: Vojko Vidmar... Mladinska folklorna skupina Mengeš vas bo s koreografijo Tomaža Simetingerja popeljala na Koroško in vam voščila »Frižekson«! To je slovenska izpeljanka nemškega pozdrava »Frisch und gsund«, s katerim so na Koroškem in v drugih severnih delih slovenskega etničnega ozemlja na dan nedolžnih otročičev, 28. decembra, hodili od hiše do hiše in pred novim letom voščili sreče in zdravja. Šego spremlja tudi tepežkanje, pri katerem naj bi življenjska moč in rodnost iz šibe prehajala na ljudi.

programme.title: The Celje Gymnasium Choir? Center and David Preložnik, 36. Celje Youth Singing Festival / Dekliški pevski zbor Gimnazije Celje ? Center in David Preložnik, 36. Mladinski pevski festival Celje
programme.desc: R: Bastich Aljaž ... follow the recording of the introductory concert of the festival, where one of the most successful youth choirs in Celje presented himself with a long tradition. The Celje Gymnasium Choir? The center has been operating at the school since 1971 and has achieved exceptional success in competitions of youth choir bands. The path to membership in the band has a meaningful choir pyramid. Singers start singing in choir 1. The year where they learn the foundations of vocal techniques and choirs, and then they can upgrade their knowledge in the aforementioned girl's band. Since 2012, the choir has been run by David Preložnik, under his leadership they have presented themselves with a varied and diverse music program. / R: Bastič Aljaž... Spremljajte posnetek uvodnega koncerta festivala, na katerem se je predstavil eden od najuspešnejših mladinskih pevskih zborov v Celju z dolgoletno tradicijo. Dekliški pevski zbor Gimnazije Celje ? Center na šoli deluje že od leta 1971 in dosega izjemne uspehe na tekmovanjih mladinskih zborovskih zasedb. Pot do članstva v zasedbi ima smiselno zasnovano zborovsko piramido. Pevke začnejo s petjem v zboru 1. letnika, kjer se naučijo temeljev vokalne tehnike in zborovstva, nato pa lahko svoje znanje nadgrajujejo v omenjeni dekliški zasedbi. Od leta 2012 zbor vodi David Preložnik, pod njegovim vodstvom so se predstavile s pestrim in raznovrstnim glasbenim programom.

Štiri poetične plesne uprizoritve razkrivajo umetniške vizije in interpretacije človeškega telesa ter predstavljajo koreografovo edinstveno ustvarjalnost. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Gaza, the trap of the Aid of Emiliano Bos exactly two years after the start of the war in response to the Hamas massacre of 7 October 2023, while the current affairs recorded peace proposals awaiting developments, we returned to Israel this time to document the traps of the aid system, also entering the large food deposit inside the strip where the mountains of boxes and bags of flour lie in Gaza. half a million Palestinians. Meanwhile, thousands of civilians killed waiting for a food package are now. In the Gaza strip we don't only die from Israeli bombs. For months, a growing number of Palestinians has been hit while desperately trying to grab food. The very few food distribution points have turned into gigantic militarized traps. Ocular witnesses and international organizations accuse the Israeli army of war crimes because it shoots against people waiting for humanitarian assistance. A version confirmed as a bonfire by a former contractor of the discussed "Gaza Humanitarian Foundation" (GHF), the American organization desired by the White House to which Israel has contracted most of the management of aid to Gaza by subtracting it from the UN. Gaza, what does Switzerland do? Di Marzio Pescia and Damiano Dignola demonstrations in the square, appeals, open letters, complaints and petitions. As in many other countries, even in Switzerland there is a civil society that mobilizes and asks for sanctions against Israel and concrete measures to end the tragedy of the civilian population in the Gaza strip. However, official Switzerland does not want to know. The words of condemnation and the invitations to a cease are not lacking fire, but nothing more. Is this right? Hebron, an enforceable lives of Emiliano Bos a railing to protect himself from the attacks of the settlers, the closed military check-point returning from work, the curfew which makes you live as in prison. The rumors from Hebron, the historic Palestinian city where the soldiers protect the settlers within a now desert urban center. And the voices from Ma’Ale Adumim, where instead the Israeli mayor defines the expansion of the enormous settlement "natural" to create continuity with Jerusalem, a project just approved after thirty years of waiting. Separate, segregated, often locked up lives, in a West Bank where history and geography intertwine inexorably while the hypothesis of the "two states" seems more and more to blend. Falò has collected the testimonies of those who cannot escape and feel in a cage. And of those who say they are convinced that "all this will be Israel". And that the Palestinians will continue to have a freedom of movement. A right that today, when you travel these separate roads, appears really trampled. The raids of the settlers of Katie Arnold since the beginning of the war of 7 October 2023, in the West Bank thousands of Palestinians have been displaced. In Israel, it is ethnicity, not citizenship, which determines if your home survives. This report documents an attack of settlers, this time in a Bedouin village. There are about 200 thousand Bedouins who live in the Negev desert but, despite being citizens of Israel, the state destroys their homes. And so, in some areas the Israeli settlements are built above the rubble of the Bedouin houses, whose inhabitants, not having another place to live, have to start building again. / Gaza, la trappola degli aiuti di Emiliano Bos A due anni esatti dall’inizio della guerra in risposta al massacro di Hamas del 7 ottobre 2023, mentre l’attualità registra proposte di pace in attesa di sviluppi, siamo tornati in Israele questa volta per documentare le trappole del sistema degli aiuti, entrando anche nel grande deposito alimentare dentro la Striscia dove giacciono montagne di scatolame e sacchi di farina quando a Gaza la carestia colpisce mezzo milione di palestinesi. Intanto sono ormai migliaia i civili uccisi in attesa di un pacco alimentare. Nella Striscia di Gaza non si muore solo per le bombe israeliane. Da mesi un numero crescente di palestinesi viene colpito mentre cerca disperatamente di accaparrarsi del cibo. I pochissimi punti di distribuzione alimentare si sono trasformati in gigantesche trappole militarizzate. Testimoni oculari e organizzazioni internazionali accusano l’esercito israeliano di crimini di guerra perche spara contro la gente in attesa di assistenza umanitaria. Una versione confermata a Falò da un ex contractor della discussa “Gaza Humanitarian Foundation” (GHF), l’organizzazione americana voluta dalla Casa Bianca a cui Israele ha appaltato gran parte della gestione degli aiuti a Gaza sottraendola all’ONU. Gaza, cosa fa la Svizzera? di Marzio Pescia e Damiano Dignola Manifestazioni di piazza, appelli, lettere aperte, denunce e petizioni. Come in molti altri Paesi, anche in Svizzera c’è una società civile che si mobilita e chiede sanzioni contro Israele e misure concrete per porre fine alla tragedia della popolazione civile nella Striscia di Gaza. La Svizzera ufficiale però non vuole saperne. Le parole di condanna e gli inviti ad un cessate il fuoco non mancano, ma niente di più. È giusto così?Hebron, vite rinchiuse di Emiliano Bos Un’inferriata per proteggersi dagli attacchi dei coloni, il check-point militare chiuso tornando dal lavoro, il coprifuoco che ti fa vivere come in prigione. Le voci da Hebron, la storica città palestinese dove i soldati proteggono i coloni all’interno di un centro urbano ormai deserto. E le voci da Ma’ale Adumim, dove invece il sindaco israeliano definisce “naturale” l’espansione dell’enorme insediamento fino a creare continuità con Gerusalemme, un progetto appena approvato dopo trent’anni di attesa. Vite separate, segregate, spesso rinchiuse, in una Cisgiordania dove storia e geografia s’intrecciano inesorabilmente mentre sembra sfumare sempre più l’ipotesi dei “due Stati”. Falò ha raccolto le testimonianze di chi non può scappare e si sente in una gabbia. E di chi si dice convinto che “tutto questo sarà Israele”. E che i palestinesi continueranno ad avere una libertà di movimento. Un diritto che oggi, quando si percorrono queste strade separate, appare davvero calpestato. Le razzie dei coloni di Katie Arnold Dall’inizio della guerra del 7 ottobre 2023, in Cisgiordania migliaia di palestinesi sono stati sfollati. In Israele, è l’etnia, non la cittadinanza, che determina se la tua casa sopravvive. Questo reportage documenta un attacco di coloni, questa volta in un villaggio beduino. Sono circa 200mila i beduini che vivono nel deserto del Negev ma, nonostante siano cittadini di Israele, lo Stato distrugge le loro case. E così, in alcune zone gli insediamenti israeliani vengono costruiti sopra le macerie delle case beduine, i cui abitanti, non avendo un altro posto dove vivere, devono ricominciare a costruire.
